Name: Skeleton Hackstruct
Information:
**Skeleton Hackstruct**

A cluster of bones forming an unspeakable mass of undeath which can contort and reconstruct itself at will. This cluster is often the result of a necromancer who has left-over incomplete bodies that they wish to put to some use, and so extract every last bone and puzzle them together into this terrifying abomination.

Stat Blocks.title: Skeleton Hackstruct
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can’t speak

traits.name: Grapple Punisher
traits.description: The jagged construction of the skeleton’s body causes any creature who grapples it to take 5 (1d8) piercing damage when they start grappling it, and again at the start of each of their turns while grappling it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The skeleton makes two Appendage Assault attacks.

actions.name: Appendage Assault
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage (the skeleton chooses).

actions.name: Deathly Porcupine (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The skeleton causes bones to jut out on all sides like spears, forcing each creature it chooses within 5 feet of it to make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage and 5 (1d8) poison damage on a failed save.
